reviews.title: Needs serious update
reviews.text: The app syncs with Garmin automatically, which sounds convenient — until the data is wrong and you can’t fix it. Once a workout syncs, there’s no way to edit the distance or any other field. This is a serious issue for treadmill runs, where the watch distance is frequently inaccurate since there’s no GPS. For runners in hot climates, treadmill runs aren’t occasional — they’re a regular part of training, especially in summer. Locking in wrong mileage with no way to correct it makes the training log unreliable. A basic edit function for synced activities is needed.

reviews.title: Complete Lack of Accessibility
reviews.text:
It is impressive that an app that charges a $99.99 annual subscription in 2026 lacks even the most basic accessibility features such as closed captions for their videos.

I guess the folks who make this app assume that people with broken ears can’t run either.
